title: Arcane Additions
description: A growing collection of vanilla-friendly additions to Minecraft. Currently features four enchantments: Bulwark and Fortify for armor, Swift Harness for faster harness-mounted travel, and Ensnare, which lets pickaxes pick up monster spawners.
body:
# Arcane Additions

A growing, vanilla-friendly datapack adding new enchantments and content to Minecraft.

## Enchantments

| Enchantment | Slot(s) | Applies To | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Bulwark** | Offhand | Shields | `+2 / +4 / +6` armor (levels I–III) |
| **Fortify** | Chestplate | Chest armor | `+2 / +4 / +6` armor (levels I–III) |
| **Swift Harness** | Any | Harnesses (all colors) | `+0.01 / +0.02 / +0.03` flying speed (levels I–III) |
| **Ensnare** | Mainhand | Pickaxes | Pick up monster spawners as items (level I) |

All enchantments are obtainable through the enchanting table or anvil — no commands required.

### Ensnare — pick up monster spawners

Break a monster spawner with a pickaxe enchanted with Ensnare and it drops as an item — fully preserving the spawner's mob type and configuration (spawn delay, spawn count, player range, and more). Place it back down anywhere to restore a working spawner with the exact same setup.

- Breaking a spawner with **Silk Touch alone** behaves just like vanilla: no special drop, just XP.
- Breaking an **empty spawner** (no mob configured) with Ensnare also drops only XP, since there's nothing to preserve.
- The dropped item is renamed and labeled to show which mob it contains.

## What's Next

Arcane Additions is actively developed — more enchantments and content are planned beyond what's listed here.

## License
